# 2 Baruch Chapter 28 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** And he answered and said to me: Whatever will be at that time will bear the seal of that period; it will last twelve years.

**2** And I said to him: But is it good for a man to live at that time?

**3** And he answered and said to me: Do not ask me about that.

**4** For those who will be living then will not perceive any distress, because they will not know that it is the end of the times.

**5** And those who are righteous and wise at that time will not perceive the tribulations, for they will have gone forth from this world.

**6** But the many who are not wise — those will be in great distress.

**7** And it will come to pass that after all these things, when the time of the appointed end has been fulfilled, the Anointed One will begin to be revealed.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. The chapter closes with the crucial announcement: after the twelve woes, the Anointed One (Messiah) will be revealed (v.7). The righteous escape the woes by dying first (v.5) — an ironic consolation.*
